This is the Second appeal filed by the appellant under Section 14-A(1) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 assailing the order dated 30.4.2022 passed by the Sessions Judge (Atrocities), S.C./ S.T. Act, District Khandwa in Case arisen out of F.I.R. No.
187/2022 of P.S. Mohghat, District Khandwa for commission of offence under Sections 376,
376(2)(n), 506 of IPC and Section 3(2)(v)-a of the Prevention of S.C./ S.T. Atrocities whereby the application filed by the appellant under Sections 439 of Cr.P.C. has been dismissed.
